notes.subject: fiɲɛ nimoya
notes.rationale: רוח נדיבה: 'willing/generous spirit' (ASV/JPS/BSB) vs KJV 'thy free spirit' — no suffix in Hebrew; 'your' is supplied.

notes.subject: השיבה
notes.rationale: Root שוב here ('restore') echoes ישובו in v15 ('they will return') — the restored one becomes the means of others' return; lost in Bambara.

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Continued direct petition to Yawe from the psalm's confession.

translation: Segin n ma ⟨nin⟩ yɛlɛyeli min bɛ i ka balo kɔnɔ, ani fiɲɛ nimoya tɛna n falen.
